description: The internal channel between the Bun server and the Rust core (contract/wire/core-channel.md): its frames, the family of a method or path, routing by the owners table, the side a read is shadowed on, the shadow comparison, and the outbound queue's coalescing. Read by `bun test` in server/src/core-channel/protocol.test.ts and by roamgate-sidecar's tests.

cases.name: a JSON message is one JSON frame, compact
a body chunk is its stream id, its flags, then its bytes
a method's family: an exact name first, then the longest prefix
a path's family: an exact path first, then the longest prefix
everything stays with Bun unless the owners give a family to Rust
a family given to Rust comes back to Bun while the core is down or does not have it
a test family only routes when tests are on
a read is shadowed on the side that did not answer it, when that side has it
keys, types, lengths and values are told apart, owner's order first
a key that is not an identifier is quoted in the path
only the first differences are kept
a queued push is replaced by a newer one with its key, which goes last
a push already taken is never replaced
